title: Iran War Exposes Dangerous Gaps in US Military Medical Evacuation System
detail: Business Insider reports the Iran war has exposed dangerous gaps in the US military medical evacuation and trauma care system, which was originally built to treat wounded troops in Middle Eastern ground conflicts. Pentagon officials face mounting questions about readiness for casualties in a high-intensity conflict with Iran, including capacity constraints in the medevac pipeline and trauma surgery infrastructure.

title: Trump Declares Iran 'Failing Badly' as Yemen Conflict Widens
detail: US President Trump publicly declared Iran is 'failing badly' as conflict in Yemen continues to widen, signaling sustained US pressure on Tehran amid ongoing regional escalation involving Houthi forces. The statement underscores continued US alignment against Iranian-backed proxies in the region.

title: Pentagon Raises Official US Troop Death Toll in Iran War to 21
detail: The Pentagon officially raised the death toll of US troops killed during the war with Iran to 21, updating the Defense Casualty Analysis System figure from 19. The announcement marks the latest official acknowledgment of US military losses in the conflict, though independent reporting has consistently cited higher figures.

title: US Military Has Lost 81 Aircraft in Iran War; Total Cost Reaches $44 Billion
detail: The US military has lost 81 aircraft over the course of the Iran war as the total financial cost of the conflict has ballooned to $44 billion. The aircraft losses include combat losses and operational accidents, representing one of the largest US aviation loss rates since the Vietnam War. The $44B figure covers munitions expenditure, operational costs, aircraft and equipment replacement, and emergency supplemental appropriations.
